name: A Lesson in Divinity
summary: Your order sends you to Tanis Alderwood in Undercity’s Trade Quarter. There, a chance to show grace comes through good deeds.

sections.title: A Call for Grace
sections.body: Your order teaches that divinity means doing good for its own sake, not seeking godhood. It says tragedy brought you here. Now it asks you to find Tanis Alderwood in Undercity’s Trade Quarter. Tanis is in need and may benefit from your grace.

sections.title: Tanis’s Plea
sections.body: When you approach Tanis Alderwood, they fear you may hurt them. They insist they have no quarrel with you or your order. Then they beg you to leave them be.

faq.answer: Tanis Alderwood is someone in need in Undercity’s Trade Quarter.

faq.q: Why am I sent to Tanis?
faq.answer: Your order says Tanis Alderwood may benefit from your grace.

faq.q: What does divinity mean to my order?
faq.answer: Your order defines divinity as doing good for its own sake, rather than seeking godhood.

faq.q: Where can I find Tanis Alderwood?
faq.answer: You can find Tanis Alderwood in Undercity’s Trade Quarter.

angles.text: As a priest, your order defines divinity as doing good for its own sake. It says tragedy can threaten the grace that defined you in life.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Lesson in Divinity
